entries.title: Price completed jobs
entries.description: Apply rates, no-charge lines, diesel pricing and discounts, then mark the job as Priced. Amending a reading returns it to Completed and flags it for repricing.

entries.title: Track jobs through invoicing
entries.description: Find priced jobs awaiting invoices and record the invoice number from your accounting system. Invoiced jobs are locked against further changes and can be reviewed by month.

entries.title: Print customer and internal job cards
entries.description: Preview, print or save job cards for completed jobs. Choose a customer summary or an internal copy with work and travel details, reading evidence and capture comments.

entries.title: Manage planned machines on your own jobs
entries.description: Foremen can add, change and remove planned machine assignments on their own Upcoming or Active jobs. Unavailable job actions now explain why they are blocked.

entries.title: Read dates and amounts more easily
entries.description: Dates now use consistent day-first formats, and relative times use plain language such as “5 days ago”. Monetary amounts default to rand unless another currency is specified.

entries.title: Share job cards from your phone
entries.description: Management can open the Finished jobs list and share a customer or internal job card through an installed app.

entries.title: Keep capturing machine movements offline
entries.description: Queued departures now free machines and implements for selection on another job before syncing. Valid departure readings are no longer blocked when the phone is missing saved job details.

entries.title: Tap recent timestamps for the exact time
entries.description: Recent timestamps use readable labels such as “Today at 14:05” or “3 days ago”. Tap these labels to see the exact date and time.
